parameter_semantics: No caller parameters. Two causal observations provide measured robot state, source/bowl/TCP/goal poses and twelve world particle positions. Particle identity is intentionally removed by symmetric learned pooling.
output_semantics: Each slot is [translation xyz in metres in the current TCP frame, local rotation vector xyz in radians, native gripper scalar]. Training uses inverse(T_world_tcp_before_action) times T_world_commanded_tcp. Execution composes the represented local transform with the fresh observed TCP pose, then panda_kinematics.solve_ik uses fresh measured joints. Slots represent t-1 through t+14; execution uses slots 1 through 8.

conversion_check.description: Recompose each local label from its corresponding measured pre-action TCP pose, solve IK from measured joints and compare FK target position, rotation and gripper scalar with the demonstrated commanded target.

cut_relation: Every assigned action [180,1740) in all twelve trajectories remains supervised. The particle encoder and current-TCP residual representation preserve incoming [180,360) and outgoing [1460,1740) overlaps rather than creating a phase-only recut.
